# Who does what, agreed and evidenced: ISO 19650 project management in one place

Plannerly is the BIM and ISO 19650 platform that connects the tools your project team already uses. Write documents in Docs, plan who delivers what in Scope, check models in Verify and let File Manager get files to the right place, with templates for the paperwork (AI can draft it) and charts that update themselves.

Set your information requirements once, see every appointed party's plan agreed line by line, and accept only models that carry the data you asked for. The paperwork starts from templates (AI can draft it) and the charts show who has delivered, without chasing anyone.

Get every subcontractor's deliverables owned, agreed and signed in one plan, with dates and reminders. The BEP starts from the client's EIR (AI can draft it), models are checked before they reach your client, and the charts show who is behind before it costs you.

Agree who models what with every consultant, publish a BEP people actually read, and check each model against the client's requirements before you issue it. Files move to and from your Autodesk CDE by themselves.

Turn your method into templates and run every client's ISO 19650 process from them: documents, scope, schedule and model checks in one account, with charts that report progress for you.

Teach ISO 19650 by doing it: free courses with certificates, then a real project in which students write the BEP, plan the deliverables, agree who owns each one and check the model.

## Accountability, ISO 19650, AI and a plan people actually follow

Accountability

### Know who does what, agreed and evidenced

The responsibility matrix sits in a BEP appendix, everyone is Consulted, nobody is Accountable, and when a deliverable goes missing nobody can say who owned it. In Plannerly every deliverable and document section has one accountable team and a responsible person. Each team signs a contract with only its own work, and delivered files are linked to the work they fulfil, so the evidence builds itself.

- One accountable team and a responsible person on every line
- A contract for each team, sent for e-signature
- Requested and delivered files compared, team by team

[Agree the RACI and per-team contracts](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/raci/)

app.plannerly.com

![Plannerly Scope: elements by work package across preconstruction and operation, above the master information delivery plan](https://help-media.plannerly.com/media/82921415fdca7bd67df3f7bcbdfb268ca13abf6805f08740479d490c5ddbacce.webp)

ISO 19650

### The whole ISO 19650 process, without five spreadsheets

ISO 19650 asks for information requirements, a BEP, a MIDP built from every team's TIDP, a responsibility matrix and an audit trail - usually a Word file and five spreadsheets that never agree. Plannerly starts you from ISO 19650 templates, rolls every team's TIDP up into the MIDP automatically, and logs every decision, comment and approval as it happens.

- Templates for the OIR, PIR, AIR, EIR and BEP
- Every TIDP rolled up into the MIDP automatically
- Every decision, comment and approval logged

[What ISO 19650 asks for](https://plannerly.com/what-is-iso-19650/)

app.plannerly.com

AI

### Start from a first draft, not a blank page (AI can write it)

Nobody became an information manager to write this year's fifth BEP from scratch. Start from a template or your own file, and when you want help, Start with AI drafts an outline or a first version, Write my section answers a requirement you paste in and marks the project facts you need to confirm, and Expand and Correct tidy what's there. In Scope, AI can draft a task's description and acceptance criteria. You stay the author.

- Start with AI, Write my section, Expand and Correct
- Task descriptions and acceptance criteria drafted for you
- Pictures of each level of geometry, drawn by AI

[Start the BEP from the EIR (AI can draft it)](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/eir-to-bep-ai/)

Project management

### A plan with owners, dates and reminders that teams actually follow

The programme lives in one tool, the deliverables in a spreadsheet, and you end up as the reminder system. In Plannerly the plan is the schedule: every task has an owner, start and end dates and its dependencies on the timeline. Reminders go out 7 days before a start, 3 days before a deadline and when a task is overdue, and the Kanban board and charts show where everything stands.

- Grid, timeline and Kanban views of the same plan
- Reminders before starts and deadlines, and when overdue
- Each team's work package scheduled on its own

[See the BIM schedule](https://plannerly.com/schedule/)

Model checking

### Every model checked against what you asked for

Checking models by hand means opening each one, clicking through the elements and ticking a spreadsheet nobody trusts. Verify checks every linked element against your own requirements automatically - the property, its value and unit, and its property set - in over 60 model file formats, and shows which team owns each fix. The charts update automatically as they fix it.

- Over 60 model file formats, IFC and Revit among them
- Requirements exported as a buildingSMART IDS file

## Plannerly: your questions, answered

What is Plannerly?

Plannerly is a BIM and information management platform, built around ISO 19650, that connects the tools your project team already uses. Teams write their project documents in Docs, plan who delivers what and when in Scope, check models against their requirements in Verify and keep their files moving to and from their CDEs in File Manager, and AI can draft the paperwork when they want it to. Owners, contractors, design teams and consultants use it to agree who does what and keep the evidence. [See the jobs it does](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/), or take the [free training](https://plannerly.com/training/).

Is Plannerly ISO 19650 compliant?

Software can't be compliant on its own - your organisation and your projects are. Plannerly is built around the ISO 19650 workflow, from information requirements to the BEP, MIDP, responsibility matrix, model checking and handover, so you have the structure and the evidence an audit asks for. The free [ISO 19650 for Companies course](https://plannerly.com/courses/iso19650/) covers the rest, and [ISO 19650-2](https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:std:iso:19650:-2:ed-1:v1:en) is the standard itself.

Is Plannerly a CDE?

It can be. Plannerly stores files and connects them to the documents, scope, tasks and approvals that produce them, which is what a common data environment is for. Many teams also keep Autodesk Construction Cloud or BIM 360 and connect it, so delivered files reach the plan by themselves. [Using Plannerly as a CDE](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/89-using-plannerly-as-a-common-data-environment-cde) and [Plannerly and Autodesk CDEs, side by side](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/91-plannerly-vs-autodesk-cdes-different-approaches-stronger-together).

Does Plannerly use AI?

Yes, when you want it - to save you writing, never to replace your judgement, and every job works without it. In Docs, AI can draft an outline or a first version, answer a requirement section by section and tidy your wording; in Scope, it can draft task descriptions and acceptance criteria and draw each level of geometry. You check and agree what it writes. [How AI works in Plannerly](https://plannerly.com/ai/), [Turn the EIR into a BEP with AI](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/eir-to-bep-ai/) and [AI in construction management](https://plannerly.com/ai-in-construction-management/).

Who uses Plannerly?

Information managers, BIM managers and coordinators at owners, contractors, architects and engineers, consultancies and universities - nearly 150,000 teams in over 100 countries. Government agencies use it to check models against their requirements, and universities to teach ISO 19650. [Read their case studies](https://plannerly.com/uses/).

How much does Plannerly cost?

You can start free: the Free plan covers your first five projects. Pro adds the paid features in the modules you choose, priced per project, with editors and viewers unlimited, and you can try it free for 14 days - model checking included. Company adds custom roles, single sign-on and your data in the region you choose. [See the prices](https://plannerly.com/pricing/).

Do the people I invite have to pay?

No. Everyone you invite joins free. On the Free plan they can view your project; on Pro and Company, editors and viewers are unlimited, so every task team can work on its own lines at no cost to them. [Invite your team](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/52-inviting-team-members-to-plannerly).

How do I log in to Plannerly?

Go to [app.plannerly.com](https://app.plannerly.com/) and sign in with your email and password, or with Google, Microsoft, Autodesk, Procore or LinkedIn - whichever you signed up with. The free training has a separate login of its own. [Login options](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/62-plannerly-login-options) and [trouble logging in](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/55-can-t-log-in-trouble-logging-in).

Which languages does Plannerly support?

The interface comes in more than 30 languages, Arabic and Persian among them, and each project has its own language for its documents, templates and libraries, so a team can work in their own language while the contract stays in the project's. [Language support](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/30-language-support-in-plannerly) and [how to change it](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/169-change-the-user-interface-library-and-content-language-in-plannerly).

Does Plannerly work with Autodesk Construction Cloud and Revit?

Yes. Connect your ACC or BIM 360 hub to bring models and files into Plannerly, and Verify checks Revit and IFC models among over 60 formats. A Revit plug-in can also push your Plannerly requirements into Revit families. [Link your ACC or BIM 360 account](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/2-linking-your-acc-bim-360-account) and [Revit integration](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/49-plannerly-revit-add-on-integration).

Is my data secure?

Roles and permissions control who can see and edit each document, task and file, every change is logged, and on the Company plan your data stays in the region you choose - the US, the EU or Canada. [Security and data safety](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/96-new-article) and [roles and permissions](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/1-permissions-viewer-editor-manager).

Can students and universities use Plannerly free?

Yes. A professor or course leader registers the course for free education access, and the training is free for everyone, with a certificate for every course. [Free education access](https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/60-how-can-i-get-free-education-access-to-plannerly), [teach ISO 19650 with Plannerly](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/teach-iso-19650/) and [the free courses](https://plannerly.com/training/).
